title: 1901, July 4th At the official opening. Swings and games were enjoyed beside the decorated bridge
description: Festivities continued on the green beside the new bridge during its official opening on July 4, 1901. The photograph captures a motorized swing, along with races and games in progress. If you look closely, you can spot decorative flags and the greenery adorning the bridge. (Photo courtesy of Ralph Day)
